title: What is aplikasi offline? A short explanation
description: A short explanation of what an offline app means in practice: the work runs on your device, so the watermark text and dates stay with you.
answer: When it matters, aplikasi offline lives in three places, and the first one you open is already stale. IDMark keeps aplikasi offline on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.

Yes. IDMark keeps everything on-device, so no data plan is needed.

No. Start without login; export a backup from time to time.
